title: DINOv3
byline: Siméoni, Vo, Seitzer, Baldassarre, Oquab and colleagues, Meta AI Research, WRI, Inria, 2025
gist: DINOv3 scales self-supervised pre-training to a 7B-parameter Vision Transformer on nearly 1.7B images without human labels. It introduces Gram anchoring to prevent dense patch feature collapse during long training runs.

problem.text: Self-supervised models degrade in dense patch-level consistency when trained for long schedules at large scale. While global classification accuracy continues to rise, local patch representations become noisy and lose spatial precision.

newIdea.text: Gram anchoring penalizes changes in the Gram matrix of patch similarities relative to an earlier checkpoint. It lets individual patch features move while locking their pairwise similarity structure to that of an earlier model with clean dense maps.

claims.text: Gram anchoring fixes the degradation of dense feature maps during extended training runs without hurting global metrics.
A frozen 7B DINOv3 backbone matches or exceeds supervised and weakly supervised models on dense tasks like segmentation and depth estimation.
Distilling the 7B teacher into smaller Vision Transformers and ConvNeXt models preserves dense and global accuracy across compute budgets.
The self-supervised training recipe transfers directly to other domains such as satellite imagery without algorithmic changes.

method.detail: Curate a 1.689B image dataset (LVD-1689M) from 17B Instagram images using hierarchical k-means and balanced sampling, combined with retrieval and public datasets.
Train a 6.7B parameter ViT-7B for 1M iterations using DINO, iBOT, and distributed KoLeo objectives with constant learning rates and RoPE position embeddings.
Add a Gram loss matching student patch-similarity Gram matrices against a down-sampled 2x-resolution teacher checkpoint from early iterations.
Fine-tune for 10k steps on mixed crops up to 768x768 pixels with continued Gram anchoring to enable inference up to 4096x4096 pixels.
Distill the frozen 7B teacher simultaneously into smaller ViT and ConvNeXt students by sharing teacher inference across all student GPU groups.
Train a text encoder with contrastive loss on image captions while freezing the vision backbone and matching concatenated CLS and pooled patch tokens.

findings.text: On ADE20k semantic segmentation with a linear probe, DINOv3 achieves 55.9 mIoU, outperforming DINOv2 (49.5 mIoU) and PEspatial (49.3 mIoU).
With a frozen backbone and a 100M parameter Plain-DETR decoder, DINOv3 reaches 66.1 mAP on COCO object detection and 66.4 mAP on out-of-distribution COCO-O.
With a frozen backbone and Mask2Former decoder, DINOv3 reaches 63.0 mIoU on ADE20k segmentation, matching fully fine-tuned models like ONE-PEACE.
On ImageNet-1k linear probing, DINOv3 reaches 88.4% top-1 validation accuracy and 90.4% on ImageNet-ReaL, while scoring 79.0% on ObjectNet.
On DAVIS video segmentation tracking, DINOv3 achieves 83.3 J&F at large resolution using non-parametric label propagation, 6.7 points above DINOv2.
Distilled ViT-H+ (840M parameters) matches the 7B teacher across dense and global benchmarks while reducing inference FLOPs by nearly 8x.
Pre-training on 493M satellite images reduces canopy height estimation mean absolute error from 2.4 to 2.2 on SatLidar and from 2.42 to 2.02 on Open-Canopy.

limitations.text: On OCR-heavy classification benchmarks such as GTSRB and Logo-2K+, DINOv3 lags behind weakly supervised models like PE-core because it lacks paired text supervision during pre-training.
A performance drop of 23% remains on low-income data compared to high-income data, and a 14% difference persists between Europe and Africa.
Feature dimension outliers emerge in intermediate layers during 7B training, requiring batch normalization or PCA when using intermediate features.
Gram anchoring adds computational overhead during refinement and requires storing or evaluating an earlier checkpoint as the Gram teacher.

related.label: DINO

openDirections.label: Closing the OCR Gap
openDirections.title: Closing the Character Recognition Gap in Pure SSL
openDirections.shows: DINOv3 lags behind weakly supervised models on OCR-heavy datasets like GTSRB and FlickrLogos because it lacks text pairings during pre-training.
openDirections.open: Can self-supervised pre-training learn fine-grained text glyph associations without explicit text annotations, perhaps through synthetic rendering or crop curation?
openDirections.move: Train a self-supervised model on a curated subset enriched with scene text and measure linear probe accuracy on Logo-2K+ and GTSRB.

openDirections.label: Continuous Gram
openDirections.title: Integrating Gram Anchoring Directly Into Early Pre-training
openDirections.shows: Gram anchoring is applied as a refinement phase after 1M iterations, repairing noisy dense maps within 10k iterations.
openDirections.open: Whether applying Gram regularization continuously from iteration zero—using a slow momentum EMA or down-sampled teacher—prevents dense collapse altogether without a multi-phase pipeline.
openDirections.move: Ablate a continuous Gram penalty against a moving average buffer starting at iteration 50k on a ViT-B model.

openDirections.label: Channel Outliers
openDirections.title: Mitigating Hidden Channel Outliers in Intermediate Layers
openDirections.shows: Intermediate transformer layers develop extreme channel-wise outliers that require batch normalization when used downstream.
openDirections.open: Why channel outliers emerge selectively in large ViTs and how to constrain them natively during training without damaging feature quality.
openDirections.move: Test per-block LayerNorm scaling or channel-wise weight clipping on a 7B model and evaluate intermediate-layer probe stability.

openDirections.label: Multimodal Encoders
openDirections.title: End-to-End Multimodal Alignment With Frozen Dense Features
openDirections.shows: dino.txt aligns a text encoder to frozen DINOv3 features, achieving 24.7 mIoU on zero-shot ADE20k segmentation.
openDirections.open: How well frozen DINOv3 features integrate into modern visual language models compared to CLIP or SigLIP backbones on complex reasoning tasks.
openDirections.move: Replace the visual encoder in an open-source VLM with frozen DINOv3 ViT-L and evaluate on spatial reasoning benchmarks like MMMU and RefCOCO.

glossary.plain: A square matrix containing pairwise dot products between all patch features in an image, capturing spatial relationship patterns.
Extra learnable tokens appended to the input sequence that absorb background noise without carrying spatial information.
Evaluating frozen features by training a single linear layer on top without updating the backbone weights.
A position encoding method that injects spatial coordinates by rotating query and key vectors in attention heads.
A shallow transformer classifier trained on top of frozen features across space and time to evaluate video representations.
Correct Localization metric measuring the percentage of images where a predicted bounding box overlaps ground truth by over 50% IoU.
Satellite imagery geometrically corrected so that scale is uniform and terrain distortions are removed.
Transferring models trained on synthetic data to perform accurately on real-world sensory inputs.
